# v3.4.2 release verification

Validated on 2026-11-04. Root, library, and docs manifests all target **3.4.2**. The previous published release is v3.4.0.

## Package candidate

- **144,656 exports across 94 catalogs**.
- New catalogs: Health Icons v3 (Healthicons 3.1.0, 1,552 exports) and Cool Icons v5 (Coolicons 5.2.0, 19,860 exports).
- The two-major-version policy retains Health Icons v2 and Cool Icons v4 unchanged and retires Health Icons v1 and unversioned Cool Icons v2.5.
- Existing catalogs gain 518 names, lose 2 upstream names, and update 125 values against v3.4.0. No compatibility aliases were added.
- Healthicons upstream commit `1f03f29e09320d6681b4770400c6d9c0b322baa1` is publicly available and recorded by the submodule pointer.
- Package runtime and optional dependency counts: **zero**.

| Command or check                                                          | Result                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pnpm outdated -r --format json` before versioning and after verification | Permitted dependencies are current; only the pinned TypeScript 6.0.3 major and current-but-deprecated Dripicons 2.0.0 are listed.                                                               |

| `pnpm audit --json` before versioning and after verification              | Zero findings at every severity.                                                                                                                                                                |
| `pnpm install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts`                           | Passed.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `pnpm format`                                                             | Passed.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `pnpm verify`                                                             | Passed: formatting, lint, two-major-version policy, 12 extractor tests, all-catalog runtime/declaration/JSON consistency, full icon generation, 17-route docs SSG build, and TypeScript checks. |
| `pnpm --dir docs check:qpress`                                            | Passed for all 17 Markdown routes.                                                                                                                                                              |
| `pnpm --dir icons pack --pack-destination <artifact directory>`           | Passed, including its build prepack.                                                                                                                                                            |
| Packed manifest and file checks                                           | Version 3.4.2; all 94 catalog import/type/JSON targets present and byte-identical to the working outputs; retired catalogs, build sources, tests, node_modules, and docs app absent.            |
| Clean consumer `npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund`        | Passed using the local tarball and TypeScript 6.0.3.                                                                                                                                            |
| Consumer `node runtime.mjs`                                               | Passed: root stub and all 94 catalog subpaths load, JSON/export lists agree, and all 144,656 values are nonempty strings.                                                                       |
| Consumer `tsc --project tsconfig.json`                                    | Passed, strict NodeNext with skipLibCheck disabled and imports from all 94 declaration entries.                                                                                                 |
| `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`                                          | Passed.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Browser smoke check                                                       | Chrome 156: all 17 routes return HTTP 200, all stylesheet references resolve, sampled pages render with zero page errors or failed local assets.                                                |
| `git diff --check`                                                        | Passed before the family commits.                                                                                                                                                               |

Full build, package, and browser logs are available under `/tmp/svg-342-release-jm3p8q3b` and `/tmp/svg-342-*.log`. The two upstream/source deprecation exclusions above are explicit; no security findings were suppressed.
